items.discussion: perf-b-45 (Order 45); sweeps/order45/REPORT-perf-b-45.md; M103 (the CPU half, fixed), M95
items.title: peak memory is still +20% over v0.42.1 on kolt after M103's fixes (VmHWM 1,030–1,079 MB vs 831–876 in the LSP): std's growth this order (the reactive hash collections' ~30 operator impls, loaded by every reactive program) costs memory-heavy work — `compute_resource_types` mints 297k type slots per analysis (115k before maps-45), `check_resource_moves` 21 → 60 ms and +33 MB
items.body: Instructions fell 31–55% under v0.42.1 but CPU only 0–25%, for the same reason. Rec: (1) stop minting in `compute_resource_types` (M95's 'classify only what consumers ask' — the narrowing perf-45 did not take); (2) do not load the map/set operator module for a program that names none of it (split it out of `std::reactive`'s re-export, or load lazily); (3) type interning. Sizing M; perf lane, Order 46 FIRST with M107's remainder.

items.discussion: perf-b-45 (Order 45); sweeps/order45/REPORT-perf-b-45.md; E236 (`scripts/lsp-latency.py`), E124 (the dead-code clock)
items.title: E236's harness never pauses 600 ms, so it never sees the dead-code clock's cost: a real pause after a leaf keystroke runs THREE analyses and 3.65 s of CPU where the harness reports 1.1 s
items.body: Add a keystroke-plus-pause row and an instruction-count column (perf-b-45's `pause.py`, `instr_lsp.py` under `sweeps/order45/perf-b-45/`); the harness's kolt copy also lacks the gitignored `src/search-dict/` (17 const-eval errors; timings unaffected). Sizing S; with M105's S1.
